title: Training a General Purpose Automated Red Teaming Model

bias_targets.methodology: Using an automated red teaming model to generate adversarial prompts aimed at eliciting ethnic slurs from a target LLM, and measuring the attack success rate using an LLM-as-a-judge rubric.

Using an automated red teaming model to generate adversarial prompts designed to elicit content that attacks a person's identity, evaluating the success rate of these attacks against the target model using an LLM-as-a-judge.
